title: Employ staff under the Road Transport (Long Distance Operations) Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Road Transport (Long Distance Operations) Award 2020.

sources.title: Road Transport (Long Distance Operations) Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the private transport industry engaged in long distance operations and their employees in the classifications listed in clause 12 — Classifications to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Road Transport (Long Distance Operations) Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 In this award: (a) private transport industry means the transportation by road of all materials whether in a raw or manufactured state, or of livestock, throughout Australia; (b) long distance operation means any interstate operation

sources.title: Road Transport (Long Distance Operations) Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 In this award: (a) private transport industry means the transportation by road of all materials whether in a raw or manufactured state, or of livestock, throughout Australia; (b) long distance operation means any interstate operation, or any return journey where the distance travelled exceeds 500 kilometres and the operation involves a vehicle moving livestock or materials whether in a raw or manufactured state from a principal point of commencement to a principal point of destination. An area within a radius of 32 kilometres from the GPO of a capital city will be deemed to be the capital city ; (c) interstate operation means an operation involving a vehicle moving livestock or materials whether in a raw or manufactured state from a principal point of commencement in one State or Territory to a principal point of destination in another State or Territory. Provided that to be an interstate operation the distance involved must exceed 200 kilometres, for any single journey. An area within a radius of 32 kilometres from the GPO of a capital city will be deemed to be the capital city.

reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Road Transport (Long Distance Operations) Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
